response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience with multiple languages and technologies, including C++ during his time at National Instruments, but his recent work has heavily focused on Node.js, TypeScript, and other modern web technologies. While he demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and a focus on quality, his recent C++ experience is limited, and there is no clear evidence of involvement in industrial automation, secure development lifecycle practices (e.g., IEC 62443), or cloud platform solutions required for this role. His background in IoT or industrial protocols is also absent.
strengths: Strong background in C++ (used at National Instruments for low-latency applications)
Demonstrated expertise in software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, refactoring)
Proven ability to design scalable, high-performance systems (e.g., micro-services at Dunnhumby)
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (last significant C++ work was in 2015)
No direct experience with industrial automation, IoT, or relevant protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)
No documented experience with Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) or IEC 62443 standards

key_factors.factor: Secure development lifecycle (SDL) and cybersecurity standards
